elements.element: Cap applies mutually to each Party's aggregate liability
elements.evidence: "each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed"

elements.element: Cap limb (a): fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim
elements.evidence: "in the twelve (12) months immediately preceding the event giving rise to the claim" — an event anchor, not the claim anchor required by the position

elements.element: Cap limb (b): USD 1,000,000 floor, expressed as the greater of the two limbs
elements.evidence: "the greater of (a) ... and (b) one million U.S. dollars (US$1,000,000)"
"IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY ... BE LIABLE ... FOR SPECIAL, INDIRECT, PUNITIVE, INCIDENTAL OR CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES"

elements.element: Uncapped carve-out for breach of confidentiality obligations
elements.evidence: "'Excluded Claims' means a Party's breach of its confidentiality obligations under Article X"

elements.element: Uncapped carve-out for data protection and security obligations
elements.evidence: Excluded Claims list contains no data protection or security limb: "confidentiality obligations ... indemnification obligations ... gross negligence, willful misconduct or fraud ... infringement"

elements.element: Uncapped carve-out for infringement of the other party's IP
elements.evidence: "its infringement of the other Party's intellectual property rights"

elements.element: Customer's payment obligations are not 'damages' for cap purposes
elements.evidence: "Ono's obligation to pay amounts due under Article VI and Article VII shall not constitute damages" — limited to two enumerated Articles rather than Customer's payment obligations/all amounts due

elements.element: Fallback: mutual cap of 12 months' fees
elements.evidence: cap is "the greater of (a) ... and (b) one million U.S. dollars", i.e. a greater-of cap, not a 12 months' fees cap; fee limb also anchored to "the event giving rise to the claim"
"breach of its confidentiality obligations under Article X"

elements.element: Fallback carve-out: gross negligence and wilful misconduct

reasons: Preferred fee limb is anchored to "the event giving rise to the claim" rather than the required "12 months preceding the claim"; change the anchor to the claim and use the fees basis wording.
No uncapped carve-out for data protection or security obligations, which the preferred position expressly requires; add these to the Excluded Claims definition.
The payment-obligations carve-out is narrowed to "amounts due under Article VI and Article VII" instead of Customer's payment obligations / all amounts due generally.
The fallback is a straight 12 months' fees cap; the inserted greater-of cap with the USD 1,000,000 floor is a preferred-only amount and cannot be used to satisfy the fallback bargain.

Intent is impaired by the unresolved cross-reference "confidentiality obligations under Article X", which is a placeholder and creates a dangling reference; it should cite the actual confidentiality Article.
Insertion itself is appropriately concise for an absent cap clause, so minimality is satisfied.
